verdict.rationale: Braintrust clearly processes many items at once: evals run across whole datasets, online scoring and Topics apply automatically to every logged trace, and logs can be exported in bulk as CSV/JSON or pulled with `bt sync pull`. The API and CLI also allow programmatic management that could be scripted for batch work. However, nothing documents explicit bulk actions on selected items, such as multi-select edit, tag, delete or move, or batch API endpoints. missing for 10: documented bulk edit/tag/delete of selected logs or dataset rows, batch API/CLI mutation endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
